name: Haus Fischbacher
beschreibung:
Sunnily and quietly located in the village of Ebbs, Haus Fischbacher welcomes guests with well-tended rooms and warm personal care. It is a relaxing retreat in the lower Inn valley.

The Fohlenhof Ebbs stud farm, the Zahmer Kaiser range, and Kufstein Fortress are only minutes away.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Fischbacher in Ebbs provides comfortable accommodations in the scenic Kufsteinerland.
